structured_output.notes: OBJECT CAST: Domain boxes (medium isometric, labeled: Marketing, Sales, Research, Data, Support, Legal, Product); request slip (small flat card that travels); hand-off cable (ink line with kraft edges per GATE T cable law); output block (solid block assembled from streams); competitor tile (flat isometric plate); contract plate (flat center-stage plate, B06 only); command chip (small rounded rect, B08 only). Five to seven objects per beat maximum. B00 establishes the full domain-box cluster; B01–B08 pull the same boxes back on stage without re-introducing them. CARD CHOICES: No ShowTellCard beats — all nine body beats are isometric Manim drawings. Card test applied: (1) none of the ideas are pure interfaces, single metrics, or one-word reveals — all are flows, hand-offs, or collections of domain parts; (2) the motions are connections and transformations that Manim draws more clearly than any card kind; (3) the domain-box cast already shows every concept as clearly as a chart or search card would. Film with zero cards is normal and complete per the skill. OPEN FACT-CHECKS: (a) The '110x MCP usage' figure (original B07, attributed to ClaudeDevs post on X) is deliberately dropped — attributed to a single social post with uncertain provenance; if reinstated, verify against a primary source and attribute on-screen per Law 8; (b) Four hand-off examples (research→marketing, research→sales, data→marketing, support→product) derive from ch13-combining-plugins.txt — verify chapter text before production; (c) 'The whole sequence runs from one command' (B08) is a conceptual claim about custom plugins — verify against current Claude plugin directory documentation that multi-step workflows can be packaged as a single custom plugin command before marking FACTCHECK.md PASS; (d) 'Fable 5' as modelLabel in BHTF is carried from the source — verify current model name before production. GATE T NOTES: Cable connectors must use deep-kraft edges (#9C8462) not ink, to prevent joining domain boxes into one 'text' blob. Signal nodes in B04 must be above radius 1 with ink outlines (not dark-kraft) to avoid sub-floor text reads. The 2×2 grid in B07 must have gaps between cells; packed dark-ink boxes fuse under codec noise. The command chip in B08 should sit on a dark plinth (pale kraft alone fails Gate V contrast). BIDEA correction: 'manage which one Claude uses' → 'keep every hand-off intentional' — the naive question is about tool routing (automatic, not the user's job); the corrected question is about intentional hand-offs (the human's actual job). This is the film's thesis, stated once at the start and demonstrated beat by beat. CONVERSION SCOPE: All six VRSegmentCard act-headers dropped; all seven pantry doodle beats dropped; all four Remotion vignette beats (grounded-vs-generic, two-halves, informed-vs-instinct, blind-spots) dropped; verdict card (V01) and BVDT eliminated under bookend_exempt; original cold open replaced by BIDEA. Teaching content preserved: all four hand-off examples (B03–B06), the four habits (B07), and the workflow-to-plugin concept (B08). Estimated runtime: ~145 s narration + silence pads ≈ 2.5 min.
